versions.content: function Validate [SWS_DM_01827] Upstream: RS_Diag_04256 , RS_Diag_04273 virtual ara::core::Future < void > Validate ( SovdRequestMethod request Method, const MetaInfo &metaInfo) noexcept; Called for every SOVD request message. Will be called multiple times if the request is for a resource collection: • once for the resource collection, • once for each resource in the resource collection. Header-Datei #include "ara/diag/sovd_service_validation.h" class mono Scope class ara::diag::SovdServiceValidation class mono Exception-Sicherheit exception safe class mono Thread-Sicherheit conditional whether the function has to be implemented thread safe or non-thread safe is determined by the ConcurrencyType given in the constructor class mono Parameter (in) th Parameter th Beschreibung td requestMethod td The HTTP method used in the SOVD request message. td metaInfo td MetaInfo of the request (includes the path of the requested resource or resource collection). Rückgabewert th Typ th Beschreibung td ara::core::Future < void > td Value if the request is allowed, or an error. Fehler th Fehlercode th Beschreibung td DiagSovdErrc ::kSovdServerMisconfigured td rollback_semantics The SOVD server is not configured correctly, e.g. required configuration files or other data is missing. td DiagSovdErrc ::kPreconditionNotFulfilled td rollback_semantics The preconditions to execute the method are not fulfilled. td DiagSovdErrc ::kTemporarilyNotAvailable td rollback_semantics The request currently can’t be served, e.g. in case the access token currently can’t be verified (e.g. because online verification is needed and the authentication server can’t be reached). td DiagSovdErrc ::kInsufficientAccessRights td rollback_semantics The SOVD client does not have the right to access the resource.
